## Purpose

Identify which rule stopped an action, from the rule code the system reports.

## Applies to

The person responsible for the shop's database.

## How to use this reference

Every rule the database enforces has its own code, from GR001 up. When the
system refuses an action, it reports the code of the rule that refused it.
Find the code in the table below. The **Added in** column names the database
file where the rule is defined.

This table is read from the database files in `sql/` each time the manual is
built. It always matches the system as it is.
